ValidationRule.description: Rescheduled Date must be current or future date. It cannot be in the Past. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - Shred") && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Rescheduled_Date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Rescheduled_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Rescheduled_Date__c) < TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Rescheduled_Date__c)) || DATEVALUE(Rescheduled_Date__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Rescheduled_Date__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Rescheduled_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Rescheduled_Date__c) < TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rescheduled Date must be current or future date. It cannot be in the Past.
